d:
Bloomberg wealth reporter Sophie Alexander tells Bloomberg This Weekend how wealthy Atherton homeowners are using accessory dwelling units meant to help ease California’s housing shortage as pool houses, spas, offices and other luxury amenities. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Alexander explains how the trend underscores a widening divide between the state’s housing goals and the workers who cannot afford to live near the wealthy households that employ them.
More on Bloomberg Television and Markets
